steps.summary: Signed in as admin/admin, skipped the change-password prompt, navigated to the 'Service health' dashboard, and found 3 panels with the following titles: "Request rate", "Request rate", and "Latency by endpoint".
Replayed stored procedure s_891b4a; observed dashboard_title=fwgr17-n3 Bench Dashboard, panel_title=fwgr17-n3 Availability, panel_value=78.5.

Resumed the interrupted edit: the Text visualization had been searched but not yet selected, so I clicked the "Text" option, set the panel title to "fwgr17-n3 Notes" and the text content to "Notes for run fwgr17-n3", applied the edit, and saved the dashboard. The save succeeded ("Dashboard saved" alert confirmed). The dashboard now shows two panels: "fwgr17-n3 Notes" (with content "Notes for run fwgr17-n3") and "fwgr17-n3 Availability" (value 78.5). The Availability panel's data source was verified as TestData earlier in the replayed procedure.

On the 'fwgr17-n3 Bench Dashboard' (UID afwxc4qra08aod): added the tag 'bench' via Dashboard settings (verified in Settings → Tags field showing "bench"), set the time range to 'Last 6 hours' and the auto-refresh interval to '1m' via the top-bar time picker, and saved the dashboard. The save succeeded — the previous save persisted all changes (a subsequent save attempt showed "No changes to save"), and the top bar now shows: time range "Last 6 hours", refresh interval "1m". The dashboard displays both panels: "{{v2}} Availability" (Stat, A-series value 63.4) and "{{v2}} Notes" (Text, "Notes for run {{v2}}").

Final verification of 'fwgr17-n3 Bench Dashboard' (UID afwxc4qra08aod) after fresh reload: (a) Dashboard title shown: "fwgr17-n3 Bench Dashboard"; (b) Panel titles shown: "fwgr17-n3 Notes" and "fwgr17-n3 Availability"; (c) Time range: "Last 6 hours", Refresh interval: "1m" (both shown in the top bar); (d) Tag 'bench' confirmed visible in Dashboard Settings → Tags section; (e) Full URL: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afwxc4qra08aod/fwgr17-n3-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m
